name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan reported 29 Chinese aircraft and drones around it on 12 Nov; Trump and Xi due to meet at APEC on 18–19 Nov
state: Taiwan's military reported 29 Chinese aircraft and drones around the island on 12 Nov, the day Xi Jinping called for peaceful reunification in a Beijing speech (IBTimes UK). On 10 Nov Taiwan's defence minister said China is running area-denial drills in the Western Pacific with the Liaoning carrier group (ThePrint, citing Reuters). Trump and Xi are expected to meet at APEC in Shenzhen on 18–19 Nov. No blockade, quarantine, clash or severed channel was found as of 13 Nov.
for_you: Shipping, chip supply chains and firms with exposure to Taiwan or China are sensitive to any escalation; travellers can check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan and Western Pacific drills (Watch); no blockade or clash (Alert not met)

sources.title: IBTimes UK — Xi Jinping issues Taiwan warning as 29 Chinese aircraft and drones circle island ahead of Trump talks
ThePrint — Taiwan says China is conducting area-denial drills in Western Pacific

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
